The '''Geode Crusher''' is a piece of [[Crafting#Refining Equipment|Refining Equipment]] that can be used to open [[Minerals#Geodes|geodes]] on [[the Farm]]. The player receives the recipe after completing [[Clint]]'s [[Quests#List of Special Orders|Special Order]] [[Quests#Cave Patrol|"Cave Patrol"]]. It takes {{duration|60m (1h)|class=inline}} to process.<ref name="processtime"/>

Geode crushers cannot open [[Artifact Trove|artifact troves]], [[Golden Coconut|golden coconuts]], [[Mystery Box|mystery boxes]], or [[Golden Mystery Box|golden mystery boxes]], but still provide an alternative to paying Clint {{Price|25}} to [[Blacksmith#Process Geodes|open geodes]].
